options.why: Adding one to the diagonal would pair unequal final values, which is not a matching subsequence step.
An optimum at a mismatch omits at least one final position; top and left cover those cases and max chooses the better length.
Top and left are alternative subproblems with overlapping solutions, not counts to add.
Earlier positions can still match even when the two final values differ.

items.explanation: Skip one final position and choose the better case.
